question: How did Jesus cure the blind man?
summary: Mark 8:22-25 has Jesus heal a blind man at Bethsaida by spitting directly on his eyes and laying hands on him — twice, because the first attempt only half-worked. John 9:1-7 has Jesus heal a blind man in Jerusalem by spitting on the ground, mixing clay, anointing the man's eyes, and sending him to wash in the Pool of Siloam. Different cities, different methods, different timeline, and a different number of steps. Apologists treat them as separate events; the literary parallels suggest John has reworked the Markan tradition into something more dignified.
